data.title: Kidtime Coparenting Calendar
data.description:
Kidtime is a custody calendar that turns your parenting time into a record you can actually use.

Use Kidtime on your own to keep your parenting records, or invite your coparent to coordinate together.

WHEN IT'S YOUR WORD AGAINST THEIRS
Keep a dated record of handoffs, notes, texts and schedule changes. When you need to show what actually happened — to your attorney, a mediator, or a judge — it's one tap, not a pile of screenshots.

WHAT'S FREE
• Custody calendar for the current month
• Unlimited swaps and hand-offs
• Notes and photos on any day
• Messaging built for co-parents
• Expense logging with receipts
• Shared file vault for the plan, the order, the school forms
• Tasks — every date your order sets, with a reminder before each one

WHAT PREMIUM ADDS
• Court-ready PDF exports — timestamped: who had the kids, when, and what changed
• Attorney access — your attorney gets their own secure, view-only access to your records, hidden from your co-parent
• Parenting time analytics — scheduled vs actual, by day, month and overnight
• The full calendar — every past and future month, not just this one
• Holidays and traditions that alternate by year, carried forward for you
• Recorded calls — call your co-parent in the app, recorded and transcribed automatically
• Texts from other apps — add screenshots of your texts and keep them as one thread in your record
• Topics in Messages — school, medical and money each in their own chat
• Tone Scan — scan a message before you send it, and rewrite it if it reads worse than you meant
• Search across your notes and message history
• Expense analytics

BUILT FOR THE SITUATION YOU'RE IN
Working with an attorney, heading into mediation, or holding a court-ordered schedule — Kidtime keeps the record you'll be asked for. Already have a custody order or parenting plan? Upload it, and Kidtime builds your schedule, holidays and hand-off times from it. Or start from a standard pattern (50/50, 2-2-3, 2-2-5-5, week-on week-off, every other weekend) or build your own, set the holidays that matter, and it fills the calendar forward.

TWO WAYS TO USE IT
On your own — your calendar, notes, analytics and exports all work whether or not your co-parent ever signs up.
Together — invite them and you share one schedule, one thread, one record. They can join on the free tier, so cost is never the reason they don't.

BUILT FOR REAL FAMILIES
Multiple children, blended households, alternating holidays, and schedules that don't fit a template.

"I built Kidtime as a co-parent, for families like mine. Hearing from other co-parents about how much it has helped them is the reason I keep building it." — Vince, Founder

Questions? hello@kidtime.app

data.release_notes:
Kidtime now catches calendar mistakes before you save them.

• When a change would leave the kids with the wrong parent, you see the week and get a one-tap fix.
• Give a holiday its own days and hours, or split it between both parents.
• Snap a receipt, and Kidtime fills in the expense.
• Bug fixes and improvements.
